caption: The video showcases a coiled flexible LED light strip with blue backing and a pale circuit board studded with yellow chips, resting on a light-colored surface. Power leads connect at the left end of the coil. A white three-button controller labeled SPEED/BRIGHT, ON/OFF, and MODE lies at the lower right, where a finger rests near the rightmost button. The view opens on darkness, then the strip's glow rises into a bright, washed-out white that floods the surface. As the light continues, the cool white tone warms gradually toward amber. The previously blended strip resolves into a row of discrete, individually lit LED dots along each overlapping loop. The coil remains largely in place, its visible change driven mainly by the shifting illumination rather than obvious movement of the strip or the hand.
relations: Initial darkness gives way to rising white illumination from the coiled LED strip.
The bright white glow gradually warms in tone toward amber as light continues.
Increasing illumination resolves the strip into a row of discrete, individually lit LED dots.
The coil and hand remain stationary while the visible change is driven by shifting light.
